applies_to: Eaton PowerXL DB1 per the Modbus RTU communication manual MN040018EN, edition 12/22.
summary: The PowerXL DB1 talks Modbus RTU on its RJ45 RS-485 socket. Eaton numbers every value by an ID: a small process-data block (command, speed reference, status/fault word, speed, current) plus parameter IDs. Every value is a single 16-bit register with an implied decimal point. This map covers the process data and the communication settings.

addressing.note: The manual numbers registers from ID 1. Its frame examples read status ID 6 with start address 0005h and write command ID 1 to address 0000h, so ID n is wire address n-1.

source.title: PowerXL Modbus RTU Communication manual for Variable Frequency Drives / Variable Speed Starters DA1, DB1, DC1, DE1
source.pages: Enable and data format p. 9; DB1 comms parameters p. 13; register mapping p. 27; process data pp. 28-39; frame examples pp. 40-41

notes: Every value is one 16-bit register; the decimal point is implied (a displayed 0.3 A is sent as 3).
The manual does not state signedness for the process data; they are typed UINT16 because their ranges are non-negative (direction is a status bit).

Output power (ID 10) is left out: the summary table gives scale 1 but the detailed text says one decimal (53 = 5.3 kW). The power (ID 13) and voltage range (ID 14) words are left out because their meaning depends on the drive's kW/HP setting.

Fault numbers in the high byte of ID 6 for the DB1 (decimal, as printed in table 11): 0 no-Flt (no fault), 1 OI-b brake overcurrent, 2 OL-br brake resistor overload, 3 O-I output overcurrent, 4 I.t-trP motor overload, 5 PS-trp hardware overcurrent, 6 O.Volt DC overvoltage, 7 U.Volt DC undervoltage, 8 O-t heatsink overtemperature, 9 U-t undertemperature, 10 P-dEf defaults loaded, 11 E-trip external fault, 12 SC-ObS keypad/PC comms error, 13 FlT-dc DC ripple too high, 14 P-LOss input phase loss, 16 Th-flt heatsink thermistor fault, 17 dAtA-F memory error, 18 4-20 F analog input out of range, 19 dAtA-E memory error, 21 F-Ptc motor PTC, 22 FAn-F fan fault, 23 O-hEAt ambient too hot, 26 OUt-F output fault, 40-44 AtF-01..05 motor identification failed, 49 Out-Ph motor phase lost, 50 Sc-FO1 Modbus timeout, 51 Sc-FO2 CANopen timeout. The 'Stop' display (enable signal missing) is listed without a number and is not a fault.
Parity default: section 2.3.2 says no parity/1 stop bit, but the DB1 table prints default 2 (odd parity, 1 stop bit) for P-56, so parity and stop bits are left null.
The DB1 parameter table (pp. 53-56) is not transcribed beyond P-12 and P-56; register 164 (P-36) packs address, baud and timeout into one word and is left out.

registers.name: Fieldbus command
registers.description: Control word: run, direction, reset, coast, quick stop.

registers.name: Fieldbus speed reference
registers.description: Setpoint frequency, limited to the min/max frequency parameters.

registers.name: Status and fault word
registers.description: Low byte = status bits, high byte = fault number.

bits.8-15: Fault word: the fault number (see notes), 0 = no fault

registers.name: Digital inputs
registers.description: Input states; the lowest bit is DI1.

registers.name: Drive type code
registers.description: Part-number code: frame size, voltage class, phases and power index as hex digits.

registers.name: Local process data source
registers.description: Selects where run commands and the speed reference come from.

values.4: Modbus control with Modbus ramp times
values.6: PI controller, external feedback plus AI1

integration.summary: Write the speed reference to ID 2 and the command word to ID 1 (bit 0 = run), then read IDs 6-8 for status, speed and current. The control-source parameter must select Modbus first.
integration.enable: Set P-12 = 3 (Modbus control) or 4 (Modbus control with Modbus ramp times). DI1 must be held high (enable) when running from Modbus. Address, baud rate and comms timeout are sub-settings of P-36; parity is P-56.
integration.watchdog: P-36 sub-setting 'Modbus RTU0 COM Timeout' (default 4 per the table): 0 = no action, 1-4 = trip after 30 ms / 100 ms / 1 s / 3 s, 5-8 = ramp to stop after 30 ms / 100 ms / 1 s / 3 s. A Modbus timeout shows fault 50 (Sc-FO1).
quirks: Register = ID - 1 on the wire; tools with a +1 offset take the ID directly.
Function codes 03, 06, 16 and 23 only; at most 11 registers per read.
The high byte of ID 6 is a fault number, not flags.
setup: P-36 holds address (1-63, default 1), baud (default 6 = 115.2 kbit/s) and comms timeout.
The RS-485 link is on the RJ45 socket.
gotchas: Without the DI1/STO enable the drive reports 'Stop' and will not run from Modbus.
Set bit 2 of the command word to reset a fault.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
